sourceTitle: berry bounty, so here is Strawberry Conserve
sourceText:
berry bounty, so here is Strawberry Conserve
By: sonia gupta
Published: Wednesday, June 15, 2011 - 7:29am

Ingredients




2 cups Strawberries:
1/2 cup Sugar:
A dash of Lemon
3 pieces of Lemon peel

Preparation

1 Take strawberry halves, lemon peel and sugar in a pan. 2 Cover the pan and let it sit at room temperature for approximately two hours. 3 Keep mixing occasionally. 4 This will help the berries to ooze out their flavor/Juice and blend the sugar. 5 Now put this mixture over simmer heat, stirring gently till strawberries are tender (2-3 mins). 6 Take out strawberries at this stage & transfer into a glass jar. 7 Continue simmering liquid until it thickens into syrup consistency (4-5mins). 8 Discard the lemon and filter out the syrup over the berries in the glass jar. 9 Refrigerate and use whenever you want to cheer up. 10 This should last for almost a month in refrigerator. 11 A great way to consume is on a multigrain toast alongwith a Philadelphia spread. 12 Yummm.... !!!!!!!!
